title: 第7章 三天后迁坟第8章 法葬就是竖着葬
content_zh:
“哎呀，一晃眼，婷婷都这么大了，真是女大十八变啊！”
九叔看着任婷婷，颇为感慨地说着。
“是啊！太……啊！师兄你干嘛？”
文才露出一副猪哥样，刚想张口说话，不料还没说完就发出了一声惨叫。
“刚刚有只蟑螂在你脚上，我帮你把它赶走了！”
原来是林道然狠狠地朝着文才的脚踩了一下。
时刻注意着文才的林道然，看见文才露出的猪哥样和张开的嘴，就知道要是让文才说出话来，那今天师父的脸面就没了。于是就先下手为强的用力踩了文才一脚，让他说不出话来。
“哦！那谢谢师兄了！”
文才皱着张苦瓜脸委屈巴巴地向林道然道谢。
“你们要喝点什么？”
这时候服务员拿着几本菜单走了过来，分发给几人。
“几位客人，请问你们需要点些什么？”
“呃……“
九叔打开菜单，看着上面密密麻麻、扭扭歪歪的比符咒还抽象的东西，人彻底傻了，根本看不懂是什么啊！
“给我来三杯咖啡，然后来几份蛋挞和三份羊排！“
一旁的林道然看着菜单，及时地开口点菜。
“任老爷，婷婷你们呢？”
“我也要杯coffee！”
任婷婷瞟了眼林道然后，默默点了杯咖啡。
待任发点完之后，服务员收起菜单离去。任发开口道。

“九叔，不知道先父起棺迁葬的事宜，你怎么看的……”
说起了起棺迁葬的事，九叔神色也严肃了起来。认真地劝告着任发。
“任老爷，起棺迁葬这种事情，我建议你还是要多考虑考虑，这种事情毕竟一动不如一静！”
迁坟这种事情，不能轻易决定的。除非是坟墓由于自然天灾等原因导致坟墓损坏，或者家中出现了人口不宁，家道中落，祖先托梦等事情。否则无故让祖先迁动，容易败坏家道风水，使祖先动怒从而导致家族败落！
任老爷富居一方，对于灵异界的一些事情也是知道的，但还是坚定地对九叔说。
“九叔，我已经认真地考虑过一段时间了，而且当初先父下葬时，给先父看风水的先生也说过，二十年后必须起棺迁葬，这样对任家才有益处。这件事就麻烦九叔了，请九叔给定个时间和章程！”
见任发这么坚持，九叔也不好再劝了，毕竟人家是金主，愿意花钱办事，自己也只能尽力而为了。
九叔内心盘算了下时间，开口道。
“既然如此，那就三天后动土起棺吧！到时候任老爷你准备好起棺的人手即可，至于法事所需的香烛供品，黄纸法坛等，义庄可以备齐！“
“哦，好的！起棺人手不是问题，法事用品就靠九叔了，到时候把事情办好，酬劳方面一定会让九叔满意的！“
任发微笑地点了点头。
虽然任家这二十年没落了一些，但也还是任家镇的首富，这些迁坟的人手和花费都是小事，九叔愿意帮忙才是大事！
事情谈好了，服务员也端着托盘走了过来，在桌子上摆好了咖啡和蛋挞等食物。
每个人的面前都摆了一黑一白两杯饮品。
九叔看着眼前这两杯一黑一白的饮品有点懵逼，阴阳太极他倒是懂，但是这黑白咖啡，该怎么喝啊？
“师父，这咖啡就是国外的茶，跟我们传统的茶吃法不同。这杯黑色的是咖啡，白色的是牛奶，纯咖啡有点苦，所以需要加点牛奶和白糖中和一下，这样比较好喝！来，我这杯调好了，师父，你先喝！还有这个蛋挞是甜品，可以直接拿起来吃的，你也可以试试！”
林道然把自己面前的黑咖啡和白牛奶混合在一起，然后加了三小勺白糖，搅拌均匀，递给了九叔，再把九叔面前的咖啡和牛奶拿过来自己喝。
“好，道然你有心了！”
九叔欣慰地笑道。
坐在九叔对面喝着咖啡的任发，看着林道然的操作，不禁侧目，笑着对九叔奉承道。
content_en:
"Oh, in the blink of an eye, Tingting has grown so big. What a transformation of a woman!"
Uncle Jiu looked at Ren Tingting and said with emotion.
"Yes! It's so... ah! Senior brother, what are you doing?"
Wencai looked like a pig brother and was about to open his mouth to speak, but before he could finish speaking, he let out a scream.
"There was a cockroach on your feet just now, let me help you get rid of it!"
It turned out that Lin Daoran stepped hard on Wencai's foot.
Lin Daoran, who was always paying attention to Wencai, saw Wencai's pig-like appearance and open mouth, and knew that if Wencai spoke, Master's face would be lost today. So he took the initiative and stepped on Wencai hard, leaving him speechless.
"Oh! Thank you, senior brother!"
Wen Cai frowned and thanked Lin Daoran in aggrieved manner.
"What do you want to drink?"
At this time, the waiter came over with several menus and distributed them to several people.
"Guests, what do you want to order?"
"Uh..."
Uncle Jiu opened the menu and looked at the densely packed and twisted things that were more abstract than spells. He was completely dumbfounded and couldn't understand what they were!
"Bring me three cups of coffee, then some egg tarts and three lamb chops!"
Lin Daoran on the side looked at the menu and ordered in time.
"Master Ren, Tingting, where are you?"
"I want a cup of coffee too!"
Ren Tingting glanced at Lindao and then silently ordered a cup of coffee.
After Renfa finished ordering, the waiter put away the menu and left. Ren Fa spoke.
"Uncle Jiu, I don't know about my late father's coffin removal and burial. What do you think..."
When talking about the coffin relocation, Uncle Jiu's expression became serious. Advise Ren Fa seriously.
"Mr. Ren, I suggest you give more thought to things like lifting the coffin and moving the body for burial. After all, it's better to be silent than to move!"
Moving a grave is not something that can be decided lightly. Unless the tomb is damaged due to natural disasters or other reasons, or there is unrest in the family, the family is in decline, or the ancestors have dreams, etc. Otherwise, letting the ancestors move without any reason will easily ruin the family's feng shui, make the ancestors angry, and lead to the downfall of the family!
Master Ren lives in a wealthy family and knows some things about the supernatural world, but he still told Uncle Jiu firmly.
"Uncle Ninth, I have been thinking about it seriously for a while, and when my father was buried, the man who showed him Feng Shui also said that the coffin must be moved and buried twenty years later. This will be beneficial to the Ren family. I have troubled Uncle Ninth about this matter. Please give me a time and regulations!"
Seeing Ren Fa's insistence, Uncle Jiu couldn't persuade him anymore. After all, he was the financial backer and was willing to spend money to do things, so he could only do his best.
Uncle Jiu calculated the time in his mind and said.
"In that case, let's break ground and lift the coffin in three days! Master Ren, just prepare the manpower to lift the coffin. As for the incense and candle offerings required for the ritual, the yellow paper altar, etc., the Yizhuang can prepare them!"
"Oh, okay! The manpower to carry the coffin is not a problem. It's up to Uncle Jiu to provide the supplies for the ritual. If the matter is done well, Uncle Jiu will definitely be satisfied with the remuneration!"
Ren Fa smiled and nodded.
Although the Ren family has declined a bit in the past twenty years, it is still the richest man in Ren family town. The manpower and cost of moving the tombs are only a small matter. Uncle Ninth's willingness to help is a big deal!
After the matter was settled, the waiter came over with a tray and placed coffee, egg tarts and other food on the table.
Two drinks, one black and one white, were placed in front of everyone.
Uncle Jiu was a little confused looking at the two cups of black and white drinks in front of him. He knew about Yin Yang Tai Chi, but how should he drink this black and white coffee?
"Master, this coffee is foreign tea, which is different from our traditional way of eating tea. The black cup is coffee and the white cup is milk. Pure coffee is a bit bitter, so you need to add some milk and sugar to neutralize it. It will taste better! Come on!, I have mixed this cup, Master, you drink first! Also, this egg tart is a dessert that can be eaten directly. You can also try it! "
Lin Daoran mixed the black coffee and white milk in front of him, then added three small spoons of sugar, stirred evenly, handed it to Uncle Jiu, and then took the coffee and milk in front of Uncle Jiu and drank it himself.
"Okay, Daoran, you are interested! "
Uncle Jiu smiled happily.
Ren Fa, who was sitting opposite Uncle Jiu and drinking coffee, looked at Lin Daoran's operation and couldn't help but look sideways and flattered Uncle Jiu with a smile.
